eligibility.quote: Obstacle appears in the global costmap, but the path is not updated. Robot does recovery behavior, and calculates a new path after sometime.

failed_conditions.quote: The `sequence` node in the V3 behavior tree library works differently than in V2. There seems to be no way to have two subtrees running simultaneously in V3 unless you use the `parallel` node.

loudness.quote: I put print statements inside ```PlannerServer::computePathToPose()```. It was not ticking at 1Hz.

notes: BehaviorTree.CPP V3 SequenceNode changed re-ticking semantics compared to V2, breaking periodic replanning in Nav2.
